technical.summary: Mixed signals with trend structure present but momentum indicators weak; oversold RSI lacks confirmation and price remains below key moving averages, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: EPAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 63 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — large amounts but mixed signals (1 sale, 2 purchases across 115-101 days)
sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with moderate buy conviction and extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 30) presents contrarian opportunity, though lack of recent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311), strong dollar pressures multinationals, NFP event in 1 day adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 63 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX trending + Supertrend bullish + Ichimoku above cloud provide structural upside framework, with contrarian congressional buy signal and extreme fear (VIX 311) creating asymmetric risk/reward near support 421.80.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below EMA-9/20, RSI oversold without confirmation, MACD bearish, macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, strong dollar, NFP volatility in 1 day, earnings binary in 63 days), and zero fundamental catalysts make this a false-signal trap in a recession-risk environment.

decision.entry_rationale: While ADX/Supertrend/Ichimoku provide structural bullish framework and extreme fear creates contrarian opportunity, price remains below EMA-9/20 with bearish MACD and unconfirmed oversold RSI—insufficient momentum confirmation for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) combined with NFP volatility in 1 day and binary earnings event in 63 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical support structure.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show mixed signals; fundamental/risk agents strongly bearish; sentiment offers contrarian angle but insufficient to override macro and earnings risks
decision.portfolio_note: Already 11 positions in Information Technology sector; adding EPAM increases concentration risk in high-volatility tech during recession-risk macro environment.
